cards.body:
Four years ago, I wrote the book on woks. Now, I have teamed up with @ourplace to create the wok of my dreams. 

After countless tests and late nights in the product lab, the breakthrough came down to the material itself: carbon steel treated with a super-nitriding process that creates a surface harder than the steel beneath it. The result? A wok that works harder, lasts longer, resists stains and rust, and is naturally nonstick and ready to use straight out of the box.

I believe that this is the wok that will carry me through the rest of my life. Stir-frying, deep frying, braising, simmering, steaming, and smoking, it’ll do it all.
